# orionbelt_machines (Data Source)

List machines matching every filter given, sorted by name. With no filters, lists every machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orionbelt_machines" "prod_web" {
  name_prefix = "web-"
  tags        = { env = "prod" }
  active_only = true
}

data "orionbelt_users" "oncall" {
  username_prefix = "oncall-"
}

# One grant per on-call engineer on every production web machine.
resource "orionbelt_machine_access" "prod_web" {
  for_each   = { for m in data.orionbelt_machines.prod_web.machines : m.name => m.id }
  machine_id = each.value

  dynamic "grant" {
    for_each = data.orionbelt_users.oncall.users
    content {
      user_id      = grant.value.id
      access_type  = "ssh"
      remote_users = ["deploy"]
      expires_at   = "2027-01-31T00:00:00Z"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `active_only` (Boolean) Only machines the gateway marks active.
- `name_prefix` (String) Only machines whose name starts with this.
- `tags` (Map of String) Only machines that carry every one of these tags with the same value.

### Read-Only

- `machines` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))

### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `tags` (Map of String)
